voiceAuthenticationMethodTarget|verifica.title: Voice call method: per-target verification mode
voiceAuthenticationMethodTarget|verifica.what: A verificationMode property on each include target of the voice call authentication method; our tenant returns the value voiceApproval. Neither Microsoft's voiceAuthenticationMethodTarget reference nor any community source found on 2 November 2026 names or explains it, so what other values it takes and what each does is not known.
uses: Read the voice method configuration of your tenant and record which groups carry verificationMode, so a later change is visible
Do not change the value through the API until Microsoft or a tested community source documents it
Keep the voice method scoped to the smallest group possible while it is undocumented

conditionalAccessConditionSet|actionsAnd.title: Conditional Access condition: actions and destinations
conditionalAccessConditionSet|actionsAnd.what: A new actionsAndDestinations property on the Conditional Access condition set, first seen by the radar on 1 November 2026. No Microsoft page and no community source found on 2 November 2026 names it, so its shape and accepted values are unknown.
uses: Export your Conditional Access policies now so a policy that later carries this condition can be compared with today's
Watch the beta conditionalAccessConditionSet reference for the property
Do not build policies on it until Microsoft documents it
